independence_declaration.statement: I (code-security-reviewer, session e71de159) authored none of the DG1 implementation or the round-6 repairs: F-DG1-125 was fixed by backend-workflow-engineer (83b12da, T-DG1-BE7) and F-DG1-126 by the orchestrator (3037ce2). I reported both in round 5, and verifying them is the originating reviewer's role. At start the real-repo HEAD was f03a9fa, a direct child of the freeze commit 0026a7b that adds only candidate-excluded metadata: the round-6 assignments, the candidate manifest and stages.json. The recomputed candidate ID matched in the real repo (candidate.mjs, --diff matches=true) and in a disposable clone at 0026a7b. During my run HEAD advanced to 24fac7c, the runner's auto-commit of the domain-reviewer's round-6 run. The candidate ID was unchanged, and I did not open that record. I formed this verdict without reading any other reviewer's round-6 record. All code ran in disposable clones under my run's TMPDIR and on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16 cluster (port 5491), and nothing in the candidate tree was modified.

checks_run.actual: Both computations give sha256:a7b46fbc29db6bb855495593e43f2e859305dea9d6c403fe86f73619d9fb210d (390 files); --diff matches=true. f03a9fa adds only round-6 assignments, the manifest and stages.json. checks_run.expected: the fixes match the findings' expected behaviour; no regression; no new injection/authorization/integrity issue
checks_run.actual: The testkit adds process to LOADER_BUILTINS (58-70); rule 3 (PROCESS_LOADERS line 91, check 305-306) is unchanged. The self-check adds X6-X8. The installer replaces the YAML glob parser with pnpm -r ls on the real tree (154), a stream parser (161-186), a repo-root containment check (191-194) and fail-closed rm/cp (199-204). AC-10 is added. No product code changed. The repo has no .pnpmfile.cjs or configDependencies, so `pnpm ls` runs no repo code. Observation: a single unparseable array is skipped (line 180), which can only drop a member, never add one. New Low F-DG1-127 (adjacent lint routes).

checks_run.procedure: F-DG1-125 re-test: plant every node:process / process import form (default, named, namespace, import-equals require, dynamic import, re-export, type-only, attributes, side-effect) through fileViolations(); global-process controls; legal process.env; bareAllowed

checks_run.environment: disposable clone $TMPDIR/rev at 0026a7b; node v22.22.2; host node_modules (lockfile-identical)
checks_run.expected: every import form is an 'imports package (node:)process' violation; global forms are still caught by rule 3; process.env is legal
checks_run.actual: 28/28 passed. R1-R9 and E1-E7 each give exactly 'imports package node:process' or 'imports package process'. G1-G6 are caught by rule 3 (module loader via process.binding/dlopen/_linkedBinding, process used as a value, globalThis.process). L1 gives []. bareAllowed(process)=bareAllowed(node:process)=false. The adjacent routes A1 (node:sqlite loadExtension) and A2 (fs-generated import) give 0 violations, which is F-DG1-127.

summary: PASS. F-DG1-125 is verified closed: every node:process / process import form is now a specifier violation, and rule 3 still catches the global forms. Planted real files fail architecture.test.ts (77/77 baseline). F-DG1-126 is verified closed: the copy-back destinations are pnpm's own member list from the real tree. ! exclusions and other list keys are excluded, and resolve, parse and outside-path errors fail the install. AC-10 passes, and an independent probe and a fail-closed probe confirm it. The other checks are all green: typecheck, build, lint, OpenAPI, no-CDN, format, unit 270/270, integration 200/200 twice on fresh PG16, tools 105/105, deploy 59/59, SBOM, DG0 historical and CI-file identity. BLOCKED only for network: AC-1 (effect) and the real-repo frozen install (registry unreachable), both covered offline. One new finding, Low and not mandatory: F-DG1-127 (node:sqlite loadExtension and fs-generated-code routes past the module lint).
